verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that the complete LlamaCloud platform, including LlamaParse and LlamaExtract, can be deployed entirely within your own infrastructure (self-hosted or BYOC) via Helm charts on Kubernetes on AWS, Azure, or GCP, keeping data and models under your control. The enterprise-readiness page also lists single-tenant, BYOC, self-hosting, and regional endpoints. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of self-hosted deployments, and documentation of air-gapped or non-hyperscaler on-prem setups and licensing or tier requirements.

support.subject: As a data engineer, I can run the extraction stack in my own VPC or fully self-hosted when documents can't leave my infrastructure

citations.quote: LlamaCloud can be deployed entirely within your own infrastructure.
Run LlamaParse, LlamaExtract, and the complete LlamaCloud platform on Kubernetes using Helm charts — on AWS, Azure, or GCP.
give you the full capabilities of the LlamaCloud platform while keeping your data, models, and infrastructure under your control.
managed SaaS, single-tenant, BYOC, self-hosting, and regional endpoints
